programs.name: NIH SBIR Phase I (PA-27-100)
programs.description: Small Business Innovation Research grant for early-stage R&D with commercial potential. Sleep/AI diagnostics fit NHLBI (National Center on Sleep Disorders Research) and NIBIB. This is the target program for SnapSleep AI.

amount.note: Phase I hard cap w/ waiver; Phase II up to ~$2.1M

programs.deadlineNote: Standard due dates: Sep 5 / Jan 5 / Apr 5, 5pm local time

programs.name: NIH STTR Phase I (Omnibus, PA-25-304)
programs.description: Like SBIR but requires a formal partnership with a US research institution (min 30% of work). An option if SnapSleep partners with a sleep lab / university.
programs.deadlineNote: Same standard due dates as SBIR

programs.name: NSF SBIR/STTR Phase I ("America's Seed Fund")
programs.description: Tech-agnostic seed grant; strong fit for AI + hardware. Requires a Project Pitch first (rolling), full proposal by invitation.
programs.deadlineNote: Project Pitch accepted on a rolling basis; full-proposal windows quarterly

programs.name: ARPA-H Open Broad Agency Announcement
programs.org: Advanced Research Projects Agency for Health
programs.description: Open BAA for transformative health technologies; larger awards than SBIR but more competitive. Abstract-first process.
programs.deadlineNote: Rolling — abstracts accepted anytime while BAA is open

programs.name: AASM Foundation Strategic Research Award
programs.org: American Academy of Sleep Medicine Foundation
programs.description: Sleep-medicine-specific research funding; smaller awards but directly on-mission and great for credibility/letters of support.
programs.deadlineNote: Annual cycle; LOI typically due mid-October

programs.name: Y Combinator
programs.description: 3-month accelerator, two batches/year. Standard deal $500K ($125K for 7% + $375K uncapped MFN SAFE).
programs.deadlineNote: Batch deadlines change each cycle — verify on YC site

programs.name: Rock Health
programs.description: Digital-health-only seed fund. Rolling investments, no cohort. Strong network of health-system partners for pilots.
programs.equityNote: Priced equity / SAFE, terms per deal

programs.name: HAX (SOSV)
programs.description: Hard-tech accelerator for startups combining hardware + software — a natural fit for camera/TRD airway hardware. Deep engineering support in Newark NJ.
programs.equityNote: Equity per negotiated deal (~10% typical for program+cash)

programs.name: Techstars Health
programs.description: 13-week accelerator with healthcare corporate partners. $220K standard deal ($20K + $200K optional convertible).

programs.name: a16z Bio + Health
programs.description: Large multi-stage fund investing in AI-driven healthcare. No deadline — warm intro strongly preferred.

programs.name: Taiwan SBIR — Small Business Innovation Research
programs.nameZh: 小型企業創新研發計畫
programs.org: 經濟部中小及新創企業署 (SMESA, MOEA)
programs.description: Taiwan's flagship small-business R&D subsidy. Phase 1 feasibility up to NT$1M, Phase 2 R&D up to NT$10M (co-funded ≤50%).

amount.note: Subsidy covers up to 50% of project cost

programs.deadlineNote: Applications reviewed in batches; next cutoff end of September (est.)

programs.name: FITI — From IP to IPO Program
programs.org: 國家科學及技術委員會 (NSTC)
programs.description: NSTC startup competition/incubation for research-based teams. Top teams receive NT$2M creation award; two rounds per year.

programs.name: A+ Industrial Innovative R&D Program
programs.nameZh: A+企業創新研發淬鍊計畫
programs.org: 經濟部產業發展署 (IDA, MOEA)
programs.description: Larger-scale industrial R&D subsidy for forward-looking technology development; suits the hardware (TRD/camera) roadmap at growth stage.

programs.name: SIIR — Service Industry Innovation R&D
programs.description: Subsidy for innovative service models — applicable to the SnapSleep AI software/subscription service layer.

programs.name: Taiwan Tech Arena (TTA)
programs.description: Government-backed startup hub: acceleration, mentorship, CES delegation, investor matching. No equity taken — effectively a non-dilutive accelerator.

programs.name: Taiwan Startup Stadium (TSS)
programs.description: Go-global accelerator helping Taiwanese startups expand internationally; strong ties to US/JP/SEA investor networks.

amount.note: Program fees / membership; investment via partners

programs.deadlineNote: Rolling membership; bootcamps announced per quarter

programs.name: AppWorks Accelerator
programs.description: Largest accelerator in Greater SEA + Taiwan, batches twice a year (AI/blockchain focus). Accelerator takes no equity; AppWorks Funds invest separately (seed to Series C).

programs.name: H.Spectrum by Foxconn
programs.description: Healthcare-only accelerator in Taiwan — mentorship from clinicians + Foxconn hardware supply-chain access. Directly relevant to airway hardware manufacturing.
programs.equityNote: Equity only if investment taken; program itself free

programs.name: Taiwania Capital
programs.description: National-level VC with dedicated biotech fund; invests seed through growth in Taiwan-linked health/deep-tech companies.
